summary: Wenatchee NF lookout at 5,397 ft: L-4 cab from 1933, tower removed or destroyed 1969. WTA says the trail is closed until further notice for the Little Giant Fire.

notes_for_editor: Tower dates conflict. The register and firelookout.com put the 40-foot L-4 tower in 1950; Willhite and the 1933 Leavenworth Echo item (quoted on the Forest Lookouts page) put a 40-foot tower in 1933. The story reports both and does not choose. Removal word conflicts: removed (register) vs destroyed (firelookout.com, Willhite). The WTA closure note is dated 7.30.26 and may have changed; re-check before publishing. The WTA page describes a former lookout site on this trail; we assume it is this lookout, which the matching 4.1-mile and Chiwawa Valley details support but do not prove. Brief elevation 1645 m and USFS agency match the register. National Register status was not confirmed (a search showed a Wenatchee NF lookout multiple listing, but not this site), so it is left out. Trail distance is 8.4 miles per WTA; a search snippet gave a different figure from a site we did not read, and it is not used. Fact-check 2026-10-09: the story now dates the WTA closure note (July 30, 2026), footnotes the WTA views sentence, and says the WTA trail's views come from a former lookout site instead of the summit area. WTA directions (85 miles on Highway 2, Highway 207, Chiwawa Loop Road) were confirmed.
